rooms.name: Entrance to the Darkwood Forest
rooms.desc:
You stand among huge black trunked trees that reach into a canopy of
leaves that rests like a huge upside ocean nearly forty feet above your
head. The underbrush here is thick with thorns and wiry vines.

rooms.name: A Small Trail in Darkwood Forest
rooms.desc:
You stand on a small trail that winds through the dense undergrowth. The
path continues to the north, and you may be able to push your way through
to the east or west where a small stream cuts through the thorn bushes.

rooms.name: A Trail in Darkwood Forest
rooms.desc:
The trail continues to the north, thorns and rough branches rip at your
face and armor as you force your way through the dense undergrowth.

rooms.name: In a Small Stream
rooms.desc:
You stand about knee deep and a small stream that runs downhill to the
west. A small dirt path meets the stream to the north.

rooms.name: A Path Ending
rooms.desc:
You stand at the end of a small dirt path through the forest, a small
steam flows downhill to the west just south of here.

rooms.name: A Path in the Darkwood Forest
rooms.desc:
Your standing on a path that heads east and south through the dense
forest. It looks like you could probably force your way through the
brush to the west.

rooms.name: An Intersection in Darkwood
rooms.desc:
A trail heading north and south crosses a narrow dirt path here. This
place in the dark woods seems strangely quiet, and there is no sign of
any wildlife.

rooms.name: A Dead End
rooms.desc: The trail becomes entirely overgrown with thorn bushes here.

rooms.name: A Turn in the Path
rooms.desc:
The path turns here running west and north.  There is something sinister
about the forest here, the deep shadows among the trees and brush seem
to shift and twist before your eyes, stretching strange darks ribbons
across the path around you.

rooms.name: On a Path Through Darkwood Forest
rooms.desc:
There is something sinister about the forest here, the deep shadows
among the trees and undergrowth seem to shift before your eyes, casting
strange dark ribbons across the path.

rooms.name: A T-Intersection in the Path
rooms.desc:
You stand at an intersection, the path continues to the west and east. 
The western branch of the path is almost entirely overgrown with thick
thorn bushes and vines.

rooms.name: An Overgrown Path in Darkwood
rooms.desc:
The undergrowth here is barely thin enough for you to hack and force your
way along the path.  The forest seems a bit less dense to the east.

rooms.name: An Overgrown Path in Darkwood
rooms.desc:
The path cuts a small hole through the brush to the south here, if you
kneel down and scrunch up your shoulders you may be able to crawl through.

rooms.name: A Small Clearing
rooms.desc:
The thorn bushes and vines have been cleared away here in about a fifteen
square foot area.  An old crumbling gore stained altar stands at the
center of the clearing on a small mound.  The whole area stinks of death
and decay.

rooms.name: A Dead End
rooms.desc:
It's hard to tell if the path actually stops here or if over time the 
forest has just entirely overgrown it to the west. Either way the only
exit appears to be back the way you came to the east. A large vine
covered pit descends down into the darkness before you.

rooms.name: An Overgrown Path in Darkwood
rooms.desc:
The dark forest here seems jagged, the strange twisted shadows of huge
skeletal limbed trees and thorn covered undergrowth tower over you
menacingly.  The path continues to the east and west from here.

rooms.name: An Overgrown Path in Darkwood
rooms.desc:
The dark forest here seems jagged, the strange twisted shadows of huge
skeletal limbed trees and thorn covered undergrowth tower over you
menacingly.  The path continues through the darkness to the east and
west.

rooms.name: Along a Path in Darkwood
rooms.desc:
The path turns to the north here. There is an eerie stillness to the
forest here, as if everything living suddenly disappeared..

rooms.name: An Intersection of Paths in Darkwood
rooms.desc:
The path turns sharply to the west here. There is something strange
looking about the brush to the east.

rooms.name: Along the River in Darkwood
rooms.desc:
You stand in the dense brush along a river bank, just south of here a  
small stream runs into a wide churning river. You can hear the water as
it crashes into the banks and rocks that jut from it's foaming surface.

rooms.name: Along the River in Darkwood
rooms.desc:
You stand in the dense brush along a river bank, just south of here a
a wide river crashes against the banks. To the west you can barely make
out a rope bridge crossing the water.

rooms.name: At the Darkwood River Bridge
rooms.desc:
The forest opens up here a little at the edge of the river where a
rickety looking rope bridge is tied across the water to the south.

rooms.name: On the Rope Bridge
rooms.desc:
You stand on a rope and wooden plank bridge that teeters dangerously
over the rushing water below you. The planks look old and rotten.
you would be wise to get off this thing before you tumble into river
and drown.

rooms.name: At the Darkwood River Bridge
rooms.desc:
The forest opens up here a little at the edge of the river where a
rickety looking rope bridge is tied across the water to the north.
There is a small burned out campfire here.

rooms.name: Along the River in Darkwood
rooms.desc:
You stand in the dense brush along a river bank, just north of here a
a wide river crashes against the banks. To the northwest you see a rope 
bridge crossing the churning water.

rooms.name: Along the River in Darkwood
rooms.desc:
You stand in the dense brush along a river bank. You hear the sounds
of crashing water as the river smashes into the banks and rocks
to the north of here.

rooms.name: In Darkwood Forest
rooms.desc:
There is a small circle of grass and vines here where the brush is
mysteriously absent. You also notice that it's strangely quiet here
not even the crickets are making any noise.

rooms.name: In Darkwood Forest
rooms.desc:
There is a small mound of leaves and branches in the brambles here, you
realize on second glance that it is a small hut of some kind. the
undergrowth to the east and west is to thick to allow passage, the only
exit appears to be back the way you came to the north.

rooms.name: In the Goblin Hut
rooms.desc:
You have to kneel down to get through the small doorway, the roof of
limbs, leaves and vines is only about 5 feet above the ground.
Several animal skins and hunks of dried meat hang from the walls and
ceiling. A small hole in the roof allows smoke from a cook-fire to escape.

rooms.name: In the Dense Undergrowth of Darkwood Forest
rooms.desc:
You stand in a narrow clear area in the ocean of thorny brush and vines
where a massive Darkwood tree has fallen.

rooms.name: In the Dense Undergrowth of Darkwood Forest
rooms.desc:
There is a small circle of grass and vines here where the brush is
mysteriously absent.

rooms.name: In the Dead-fall
rooms.desc:
You tumble down the rough rock and dirt covered wall of the dead-fall to
land with a painful crash at the bottom.  As you stand and dust yourself
off you notice several nasty looking spears stuck in the ground, their
sharp barbed tips pointing towards the sky.  Your lucky you didn't
disembowel yourself on one when you landed.

rooms.name: A Cave Entrance
rooms.desc:
A low dark cave is buried in the undergrowth the east.  A few small
wisps of smoke rise lazily from it's edges.

rooms.name: In a Dark Moldy Passage
rooms.desc:
You stand in a damp mold and rotten vegetation filled passage that runs
east and west. There are a few tanned leather hides tied to poles here,
one with a gruesome image of a human skull with the side caved in,
the other with some unknown language scrawled across it in deep
red lettering.

rooms.name: In a Dark Moldy Passage
rooms.desc:
The passage turns to the south here, and also leads back to the west.
The ground under your feet makes disgusting sucking and squishing noises
every time you take a step.

rooms.name: In a Dark Moldy Passage
rooms.desc:
The passage turns to the east here, and also leads back to the north.
The ground under your feet makes disgusting sucking and squishing noises
every time you take a step.

rooms.name: In A Damp Passage
rooms.desc:
Some of the rotten vegetation and vines have been cleared away here.
Shadows cast by a few torches further down the hall to the east play
across the raw earth walls.

rooms.name: A Guard Post in the Passage
rooms.desc:
A few logs are here set on end for chair, along with a small cook fire.
The northern wall is entirely covered with various animal skins, one
stirs a little as if brushed by a slight breeze. Glancing at the
torches in the wall you can't help but wonder why these goblins would
have torches when they can obviously see in the darkness just fine.

rooms.name: A Gate in the Passage
rooms.desc:
The passage is blocked here by a large wood an vine woven gate. Furs and
various other animal skins cover the muddy floors and walls.

rooms.name: In a Secret Passage
rooms.desc:
You stand in a narrow passage leading north. The south wall is covered in
furs and vines.

rooms.name: In a Secret Passage
rooms.desc: The passage turns the the west here and heads back to the south.

rooms.name: A Small Chamber
rooms.desc:
This room is littered with bones, hunks of flesh and several other things
that you can't quite figure out what are <or where>.  The walls are
decorated with several banners of tanned leather covered in strange
writing and symbols.

rooms.name: A Large Open Chamber
rooms.desc:
You stand in an immense open chamber, the ceiling is hidden in deep
shadows about twenty feet overhead. The floor of the chamber is dotted
with cook fires surrounded by small areas of animal skins.

rooms.name: NE Corner of a Large Open Chamber
rooms.desc:
You stand in an immense open chamber, the ceiling is hidden in deep
shadows about twenty feet overhead. The floor of the chamber is dotted
with cook fires surrounded by small areas of animal skins.

rooms.name: SW Corner of a Large Open Chamber
rooms.desc:
You stand in an immense open chamber, the ceiling is hidden in deep
shadows about twenty feet overhead. The floor of the chamber is dotted
with cook fires surrounded by small areas of animal skins.

rooms.name: SE Corner of a Large Open Chamber
rooms.desc:
You stand in an immense open chamber, the ceiling is hidden in deep
shadows about twenty feet overhead. The floor of the chamber is dotted
with cook fires surrounded by small areas of animal skins. There is
a dark tunnel opening in the south wall here.

rooms.name: In a Damp Tunnel
rooms.desc: You are in a damp tunnel than runs north and south from here.

rooms.name: In a Damp Tunnel
rooms.desc:
The tunnel comes to a stop here at a large black wooden door. A tanned
animal skin with a big caved in human skull drawn on it is nailed into
the wood with iron spikes.

rooms.name: The Goblin Lords Throne Room
rooms.desc:
You stand in a large dark room, a black wooden throne cut out of a big
tree stump is sitting in the center of the room. The walls are covered
with furs and skins depicting scenes of battle and destruction.
Two poles rise on either side of the throne with rotten elven heads
jammed on then ends.

rooms.name: In a Dark Moldy Passage
rooms.desc:
The narrow muddy passage runs to the east into a large chamber from here
and west to a gate of woven vines and limbs.

rooms.name: A Moldy Damp Passage
rooms.desc:
You stand in a damp moldy tunnel which extends into the darkness to the
east. The smell of rotting vegetation and damp earth hangs in the air
here like a fog, it makes you want to gag.

rooms.name: A Moldy Damp Passage
rooms.desc:
You stand in a damp moldy tunnel which extends into darkness to the west
and east. The smell of rotting vegetation and damp earth hangs in the
here like a fog, it makes you want to gag.

rooms.name: A Moldy Damp Passage
rooms.desc:
The tunnel comes to a halt here, a small wooden ladder leads up to
a trap door made of woven vines and tree limbs.
